participants.name: Benjamin

persona.name: Benjamin
persona.personality: Benjamin is an intelligent and calm person. He is able to think calmly and rationally, and even in emotional situations, he places importance on logic. In public, he is elegant and polite, often incorporating sarcasm and humor into his conversations, but he is skilled at doing so without hurting others, creating a harmonious atmosphere. He also has an introverted side, often engrossed in deep thought, and occasionally keeps his distance from those around him. However, his calmness and knowledge are factors that earn him the trust of others even in difficult situations.

participants.private_seed: The figures approved on paper no longer survive contact with the market, and what a building costs after it opens never reaches the committee at all.

participants.name: Shizue

persona.name: Shizue
persona.personality: Shizue has a very calm and gentle personality. Even as she has grown older, she continues to smile warmly at those around her and is a very caring person. She is always considerate of others, friendly, and sometimes shows a playful side. She often reaches out to those who are feeling down with kind words and never hesitates to lend a helping hand when needed, which has earned her the affection of many people in the village and community. Through her years of life experience, Shizue has come to understand the importance of living peacefully with others.

participants.private_seed: Every recent job seems to meet something nobody priced for, and the calendar keeps slipping until a year of building is squeezed into whatever weeks are left.

participants.name: Mizuki

persona.name: Mizuki
persona.personality: Mizuki is a very confident woman who is often relied upon by those around her. She is calm and logical in her thinking and is good at observing people. As a result, she always makes calm judgments and chooses her actions according to the situation around her. Although she may sometimes come across as a little aloof, she is actually very caring and cannot ignore those who are weak. While she is relied upon by those around her and occasionally asserts her opinions strongly, she also possesses a kindness that considers others.

participants.private_seed: Looking back at what has actually been built here, nobody has asked in the open which of those projects landed well and which quietly disappointed the people using them.

participants.name: Yumi

persona.name: Yumi
persona.personality: Yumi has a cheerful and energetic personality. She is modest, yet she also has a kind side that cares about those around her. She has a calm personality, but she is very passionate toward her friends and family, and she cannot ignore people in trouble. She smiles at the slightest thing and spreads positive energy to those around her. She is friendly and can quickly get along with people she meets for the first time.

participants.private_seed: Some of us keep noticing that space decisions are settled without asking what the timetable absorbs while the work runs, or how heavily the finished rooms get used afterwards.

participants.name: George

persona.name: George
persona.personality: George has a gentle and calm personality, but he can also be a little stubborn and headstrong at times. He is seen by those around him as a reliable person with a wealth of experience appropriate for his age, and he is always able to make calm judgments, allowing him to handle difficult situations without panicking. However, his expressions sometimes reveal a hint of sternness or awkwardness, and he tends to observe things from a step back rather than actively engaging with others. He is very independent and tends to try to solve problems on his own without relying on others.

participants.private_seed: Each decision here lands on the same shrinking set of staff, and those already carrying the routine upkeep have had no relief for years.

- Booking data for specialist and general rooms

- Bench technicians' weekly manual routines

## Discussion format
The talk proceeds in rounds. Each round has 4 turns; in each turn, every participant speaks once, in this fixed order: Shizue, Yumi, George, Mizuki and Benjamin. On a turn, a participant either speaks, says "Skip" (passes this turn only), or says "Over" (takes no further turns this round). A participant can address another directly with @Name, to ask them a question, answer theirs, agree with them, or object to what they said. An utterance is anywhere from 1 to 40 words; give it the length and content that suit the moment. An utterance consists only of the participant's own words: no name labels, headings, stage directions or commentary, and no speaking for others. The talk is a conversation among the participants: they respond to one another, asking, answering, agreeing and objecting, and the decision grows out of that exchange.

## Schedule
| Round | Start of the round | Talk | End of the round |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | nothing new (the things that can be looked into are listed above, titles only) | 4 turns | each participant chooses 2 of the listed things to look into |
| 2 | each participant is told what they found out (that participant only) | 4 turns | nothing |
| 3 | everyone is told the candidates | 4 turns | every participant votes; the candidate with the most votes is selected |
- Several participants may choose the same thing; what is found out is told only to the participant who looked into it.
If votes are tied, one of the tied candidates is chosen by a fixed rule. The discussion ends after the vote.

## Looking into things
After round 1, each participant chooses 2 of the listed things to look into. What they find out is told only to that participant.

The talk proceeds in rounds. Each round has 4 turns; in each turn, every participant speaks once, in this fixed order: Shizue, Yumi, George, Mizuki and Benjamin.
